name: hip-thrust
phone: On the floor or a low stand, 2 to 3 metres away, side-on, the whole body and the bench in the picture.

ready.from: Seated low against the bench: the knees bent, the feet planted (the usual set-up, the knees well bent; not fitted).

The hips low and bent, 50 degrees or more short of straight (not fitted): only the bottom of a hip thrust, never its top, where the hips open (Kd's videos, 52c-ii: 74 to 124 degrees at the bottom, 158 to 180 at the top).

The upper back on the bench, the trunk leaning back from upright and short of lying (not fitted): a body lying on the floor, as for a sit-up, reads 70 or more. Kd's videos (52c-ii): 24 to 58 degrees at the bottom.

rules.name: depth
rules.short: Push your hips higher to count.
rules.unseen: Keep your whole body in view.
rules.from: Set by movement-check from 2 people's videos (scripts/movementVideos.ts), as filmed and as each replay that sets numbers (scripts/replays.ts), 50 reps: a quarter of the way back towards standing from the shallowest rep (0.21; standing 0).

rules.name: hips open
rules.short: Push your hips higher to count.
rules.unseen: Keep your whole body in view.
rules.from: Set by movement-check from 2 people's videos (scripts/movementVideos.ts), as filmed and as each replay that sets numbers (scripts/replays.ts), 50 reps: a quarter of the way back towards standing from the shallowest rep (160.40; standing 106.19).

rules.name: back on the bench
rules.unseen: Keep your whole body in view.
rules.from: Set by movement-check from 2 people's videos (scripts/movementVideos.ts), as filmed and as each replay that sets numbers (scripts/replays.ts), 50 reps: beyond the furthest rep by half its distance from the middle rep (56.28; standing 44.95).

rules.name: shoulders stay
rules.from: Set by movement-check from 2 people's videos (scripts/movementVideos.ts), as filmed and as each replay that sets numbers (scripts/replays.ts), 50 reps: beyond the furthest rep by half its distance from the middle rep (0.15; standing 0).
